thread:
Maya (Partnerships): Hey team — kicking off AWS/GCP/Azure listing onboarding for the new pilot customers. Need a quick sync on tenant roles, billing contacts, and legal artifacts. Who's owning what?
Aj (Cloud Ops): I can take tenant roles + test account setup. Need the publisher account IDs and an IAM checklist.
Maya (Partnerships): Publisher IDs attached in the drive link (see thread). Also need a primary billing contact for each cloud.
Luis (Partnerships): I have billing contacts for AWS + GCP. Azure contact is pending from the partner.
Samir (Product): Packaging question — are we exposing Dedicated and Hosted SKUs separately or bundling into a single offering with add-ons?
Maya (Partnerships): We should list two SKUs: hosted-api (metered) and dedicated-reserved (monthly). Legal asked for clear trial terms.
Elena (Legal): I reviewed the draft EULA. Two asks: 1) explicit data residency clause for Azure listing, 2) a short privacy/data processing addendum for EU customers.
Maya (Partnerships): Noted — Elena can we get redlines by EOD Wednesday? Marketplace deadlines are tight.
Elena (Legal): Yes — I’ll push comments and a short DPA template. Can you confirm which regions we must declare?
Luis (Partnerships): AWS: us-east-1, us-west-2. GCP: us-central1, europe-west1. Azure: westeurope (pending partner confirmation).
Aj (Cloud Ops): For tenant roles: recommend creating two publisher roles: marketplace-publisher-admin and marketplace-publisher-reader. I’ll draft a terraform snippet.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: listing intake form is due in 48h — https://docs.internal/marketplace-intake
Samir (Product): Also need screenshots and a 200-word product blurb. I can draft copy, but need one high-res logo (1024x1024) and an architecture diagram.
Maya (Partnerships): Upload logos + diagram to the shared folder, please. Samir — ping me when copy is ready; I'll coordinate marketing approvals.
Aj (Cloud Ops): Terraform snippet (quick):
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "marketplace_publisher_admin" {
  name = "marketplace-publisher-admin"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume_role_policy.json
}
```
Samir (Product): Perfect. Also flagging metrics for the listing: latency SLO (p95 < 200ms), token cost estimate, and supported model list. Ops needs to confirm p95 numbers.
Aj (Cloud Ops): I’ll export p95 metrics from staging by EOD tomorrow.
Elena (Legal): Quick note on marketing claims: avoid absolute uptime numbers unless we have contractual SLAs with the cloud marketplace listing. Use flexible language like "designed for high availability."
Maya (Partnerships): Got it. Marketing will avoid hard guarantees.
Luis (Partnerships): Partner asked about a joint press mention — can we tentatively plan a co-announcement once listing is live? Need legal ok.
Elena (Legal): We can approve a joint announcement template. Send me the draft and partner logo usage rights.
Maya (Partnerships): Action items recap:
- Aj: tenant roles terraform + staging p95 export (due +24h)
- Elena: EULA redlines + DPA template (due EOD Wed)
- Samir: product blurb + screenshots + arch diagram (due +48h)
- Luis: confirm Azure region + partner PR ask follow-up (due +48h)
- Maya: submit intake form, coordinate marketing + upload assets

Maya (Partnerships): If no objections I’ll freeze the intake and assign tasks in the tracker. :thumbsup:
Luis (Partnerships): :thumbsup: all good from my side.
Aj (Cloud Ops): OK I'll start on roles.
Elena (Legal): I’ll circulate redlines shortly.
Samir (Product): Will share draft copy by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — looping in the partner next once tasks are updated.
